fields.why: Adverse-event percentages are reported for each of the 3 age groups (<18, 18-50, >50), for any adverse event and for severe adverse events.
Age is the only SPD with 3+ groups compared; sex has 2 levels and country of exposure is a case descriptor with no per-group outcome.

Any-AE shares across the 3 age groups are only set side by side; for severe AEs, >50 is tested against the 18-50 referent (OR 2.1, p=0.06) beside the untested adolescent 13.3%, so only some pairs against a named referent: per-group vs referent only. The Fisher-test mechanical flag is a false alarm for the side-by-side entry.

brief_issues: Brief does not say whether a single 2-group test beside an untested third group's value is a 3-group result (per-group vs referent only) or a pairwise contrast with no entry plus side by side; A's reading follows the 'only some pairs' rule.
